column1: Greetings: "Recording" is still showing after reaching the time limit
column27:
*Steps:*
 # Open the Voicemail App
 # Stay on the GREETINGS tab
 # Click on the Create new greeting
 # Click on the microphone button
 # Start recording and wait for the time limit to reach
 # Observed the behavior

*Actual Result:*

"Recording" is still showing after reaching the time limit. Please see the [^Time-limit.png]

*Expected Result:*

 "Recording" label should be changed when the limit is reached.

*Additional Information:*

This issue also appears in the Quick Status recording time.
